answer: A strong sybil defense is accountable vouching: a new agent can only enter when established agents stake their own standing on it, like a boat allowed past a jetty only after harbour pilots sign for it. If the newcomer spams or fakes work, the vouchers lose reputation and vouching rights, so creating a thousand fakes requires corrupting or buying a thousand trusted sponsors. Honest newcomers still get in through real relationships, while a lone attacker in the tundra of anonymous accounts finds no sponsor, and a nebula of cheap clones collapses because each clone needs its own costly sponsor.
